versions.changelog:
2ryun-skill v0.1.3

- Documentation and skill scope have been revised: focus is now on document/knowledge base management, knowledge search, web page generation, and publishing (removes explicit multi-page site generation instructions).
- SKILL.md updated: condensed publishing capabilities, simplified web publishing flows, and clarified template selection (no more hardcoding).
- Error handling section updated: clarified 407 (Key permission) logic, removed 403, and expanded permission guidance.
- Minor adjustments to descriptions to align with current product feature set.
- skill-card.md file removed for better documentation maintainability.

2ryun-skill v0.1.2

- Added documentation for uploading, listing, and managing image/video/audio/doc attachments (素材上传 API and usage).
- Updated SKILL.md with new "能力五：素材上传" section (single/multi file upload, endpoints, formats, limits, URLs).
- SKILL.md and quick reference table now include attachment-upload endpoints and details.
- Removed redundant documentation file (skill-card.md) for clarity.
- General doc updates to improve completeness and usability.

2ryun-skill v0.1.1

- Added notes on URL encoding for queries with non-ASCII characters (e.g. Chinese) in requests—now documents correct usage with curl and programming languages.
- Clarified logic for rootId and parentId when creating documents to accurately build document trees.
- Section title "重要规则" changed to "重要细节"，with new practical reminders on encoding and document tree creation.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md documentation file.
- No API or endpoint changes; documentation only.

2Ryun-skill 0.1.0 – Initial Release

- Provides AI-powered document management, knowledge base, and website publishing for 2Ryun (第二现实).
- Supports document import, auto-extraction to knowledge base, structured semantic search, and knowledge graph exploration.
- Enables Markdown/html content creation, site generation, and public publishing, with chat-based webpage editing.
- Differentiates documents (can be added to knowledge base) and lightweight notes (not extracted).
- Includes clear error handling guidelines, API endpoints, and practical usage rules for optimal workflow.
